raw_text: Deep analysis of ShadowPad samples recovered from Indian power sector intrusions. The malware uses a modular plugin architecture with at least 17 identified modules including keylogger, screen capture, file manager, and network discovery. The C2 communication is encrypted using a custom protocol over DNS and HTTP. Notably, the samples targeting Indian infrastructure include a kill-switch date check that would have allowed coordinated activation. The compilation timestamps and debug strings confirm Chinese-language development environment. ShadowPad has been shared among at least five Chinese APT groups since 2017.
